dam-dynamics.title: 混凝土水工結構歷時動力分析
dam-dynamics.titleEn: Time-History Dynamic Analysis of Concrete Hydraulic Structures EM1110-2-6051
dam-dynamics.scope: 官方目錄確認二〇〇三年十二月線彈性歷時分析手冊；不將線性模型外推為開裂、滑動或土壩液化驗證。
dam-dynamics.scopeEn: Official catalogue confirms December2003 linear-elastic time-history guidance; it does not validate cracking, sliding or embankment liquefaction by linear extrapolation.
dam-dynamics.evidence: Official indexed turn214search1 and turn214search47, date December22,2003.

embankment-seismic.title: 土石壩耐震分析與設計
embankment-seismic.titleEn: Design Standards No.13 Chapter13: Seismic Analysis and Design
embankment-seismic.scope: 官方清單列二〇一五年五月土石壩耐震章節；材料非線性和震後穩定與混凝土線性振子分開解讀。
embankment-seismic.scopeEn: Official list dates the embankment seismic chapter to May2015; material nonlinearity and post-earthquake stability are distinguished from a linear concrete oscillator.
embankment-seismic.evidence: Official indexed turn214search0 and turn214search46 confirm scope and date.

hoover-history.title: 胡佛壩建設歷程
hoover-history.scope: 官方歷史記錄混凝土壩、鋼管與錨定工程；本課僅作結構型式比較，不將合成動力參數宣稱為胡佛壩資料。
hoover-history.scopeEn: Official history describes the concrete dam, penstocks and anchorage; used for structural-type comparison, not as the source of synthetic dynamic parameters.
hoover-history.evidence: Official indexed turn218search0 and turn214search39;1935 last main-dam concrete,1936 works and initial generation.

sisk-history.title: 聖路易水庫西斯克壩背景
sisk-history.titleEn: B.F. Sisk Dam history and modification context
sisk-history.scope: 官方記錄一九六三至一九六七年土石壩建設；僅與混凝土壩比較材料機制，不宣稱本課振子重現場址。
sisk-history.scopeEn: Official account records1963–1967 earthfill-dam construction; comparison concerns material mechanisms, not reproduction of the site by a single oscillator.
sisk-history.evidence: Official indexed turn218search17 confirms dates and zoned earthfill type.

hydraulic-lab.title: 水工實驗室技術手冊
hydraulic-lab.scope: 官方摘要確認一九八〇年手冊，涵蓋相似律、模型設計施工、設備與現地研究；算例不冒稱原文規定尺度。
hydraulic-lab.scopeEn: Official abstract confirms the1980 manual covering similitude, model design/construction, instruments and field studies; selected scales are original assumptions.
hydraulic-lab.evidence: Official indexed turn214search15 and turn218search3; date refers to publication.

froude-manual.title: 流量量測手冊佛祿數章節
froude-manual.titleEn: Water Measurement Manual: Froude Number and Critical Flow
froude-manual.scope: 官方章節說明自由水面模型佛祿數相等的概念；不代表黏滯、表面張力和氣泡效應也相等。
froude-manual.scopeEn: Official chapter explains equal Froude numbers in free-surface models; this does not also match viscosity, surface tension or air effects.
froude-manual.evidence: Official indexed turn214search18 confirms Froude-model context.

lab-projects.title: 水工模型研究官方目錄
lab-projects.scope: 官方目錄列二〇一五年克利埃勒姆魚道研究及二〇一八年福爾松附加溢洪道閘門模型；本課為方法比較。
lab-projects.scopeEn: Official catalogue lists2015 Cle Elum fish-passage studies and2018 Folsom auxiliary-spillway gate modeling; lessons compare methods rather than site results.
lab-projects.evidence: Official indexed turn218search8: HL-2015-02/03 and HL-2018-06 titles and dates.

deltares-model.title: 伊默伊登分層流縮尺研究
deltares-model.titleEn: Selective Withdrawal at IJmuiden physical and numerical modeling
deltares-model.scope: 研究機構說明一比四十物理模型與三維數值比較，特別包含分層流及量測；不能將驗證限縮成外形相似。
deltares-model.scopeEn: Researcher describes1:40 physical and three-dimensional numerical comparisons with stratification and measurements; validation extends beyond geometric resemblance.
deltares-model.evidence: Direct research-page text turn200search3, published wiki March6,2023; cited research2021.

pumped-storage.title: 抽蓄水力發電基本原理
pumped-storage.scope: 官方說明上下庫儲能、抽水耗能及開放與封閉循環差異；本課不使用即時市場價格或宣稱通用排程。
pumped-storage.scopeEn: Official explanation of two-reservoir storage, pumping energy and open versus closed loops; no current market prices or universal schedule are inferred.

psh-guide.title: 抽蓄價值評估指南與工具
psh-guide.titleEn: Pumped Storage Valuation Guidebook and Tool
psh-guide.scope: 二〇二二年官方介紹國家實驗室指南與二〇二一年工具發布，支持明確列出服務與分析邊界，不提供現場水位指令。
psh-guide.scopeEn: The2022 official article describes laboratory valuation guidance and the2021 tool release, supporting explicit service and analysis boundaries rather than field water-level instructions.
psh-guide.evidence: Opened turn240view1: March9,2022 article, tool released November2021, fifteen-step framework.

bath-storage.title: 巴斯郡抽蓄電站
bath-storage.scope: 業主記錄上下庫及一九八五年十二月商轉；作抽蓄配置案例，所有本課流量、水頭與效率均另行假設。
bath-storage.scopeEn: Owner records two reservoirs and December1985 commercial operation; course flows, heads and efficiencies are separately assumed.
bath-storage.evidence: Opened turn240view0, lines265–278; no capacity or water-level limit is prescribed by this lesson.

elbert-storage.title: 埃爾伯特抽蓄電站官方資料
elbert-storage.scope: 官方電站資料確認抽蓄型式與機組，僅作另一配置比較，不由歷史發電圖推算現在調度或效率。
elbert-storage.scopeEn: Official plant data confirms pumped-storage configuration and units; historical generation charts are not used to infer current dispatch or efficiency.
elbert-storage.evidence: Opened eight-page official PDF turn238view3, title and unit table.

hydro-structures.title: 水力電廠結構規劃與設計
hydro-structures.titleEn: EM1110-2-3001 Planning and Design of Hydroelectric Power Plant Structures
hydro-structures.scope: 官方目錄列二〇〇八年十月更新的水力電廠結構手冊，涵蓋壓力管與調壓設施；不是每座場址的操作規程。
hydro-structures.scopeEn: Official catalogue lists the October2008 update of hydroelectric structural guidance, including penstocks and surge facilities; it is not a site operating procedure.
hydro-structures.evidence: Official indexed turn237search9 and turn237search40;2008 update of1995 manual, not a project opening date.

steel-penstocks.title: 焊接鋼壓力管專論
steel-penstocks.scope: 官方清單確認一九四九年專論及一九六六年修訂；用作鋼管荷載與支承背景，不將歷史方法當成現場驗收結論。
steel-penstocks.scopeEn: Official list confirms the1949 monograph and1966 revision; used for steel-pipe load and support context, not as a current field acceptance decision.
steel-penstocks.evidence: Opened turn238view0, line37, title and dates.

penstock-inspection.title: 鋼壓力管與壓力渠道檢查
penstock-inspection.titleEn: FIST2-8 Inspection of Steel Penstocks and Pressure Conduits
penstock-inspection.scope: 官方清單列二〇二二年八月鋼管檢查手冊，支持厚度、支承及可追溯維護資料的查核；數值許用應力未由此推定。
penstock-inspection.scopeEn: Official list dates the steel-conduit inspection manual to August2022, supporting traceable thickness, support and maintenance evidence; no allowable stress is inferred.
penstock-inspection.evidence: Opened turn240view2, line39; edition title/date confirmed.

eklutna-history.title: 埃克盧特納鋼管與調壓設施歷史
eklutna-history.scope: 官方歷史描述包覆鋼管、混凝土錨塊與調壓井施工；作真實配置案例，不把本課尺寸或瞬態參數當成其設計資料。
eklutna-history.scopeEn: Official history describes encased steel penstocks, concrete anchor blocks and surge-tank construction; synthetic dimensions and transient parameters are not site design data.
eklutna-history.evidence: Opened turn238view2 and found turn248view1 lines99–106: surge excavation1953, lining1954, anchor block and encased penstock.

coachella-surge.title: 科切拉配水管網湧浪控制專論
coachella-surge.titleEn: Engineering Monograph17: Surge Control on the Coachella Pipe Distribution System
coachella-surge.scope: 官方目錄確認一九五四年配水管網湧浪控制專論；與水力電廠調壓井比較邊界，不宣稱兩系統可沿用同一控制參數。
coachella-surge.scopeEn: Official catalogue confirms the1954 distribution-system surge-control monograph; its boundaries are compared with hydropower shafts without transferring operating parameters.
coachella-surge.evidence: Opened turn238view0 line51; PDF link exists but retrieval failed turn259view2, so scope limited to verified catalogue title/date.

coachella-project.title: 全美運河與科切拉配水工程
coachella-project.titleEn: All-American Canal and Coachella distribution system
coachella-project.scope: 官方歷史記錄科切拉配水工程與一九五四年完成背景；僅定位管網比較案例，不將開渠與壓力管瞬態混為相同方程。
coachella-project.scopeEn: Official history records the Coachella distribution works and1954 completion context; used to locate the network comparison, not equate open-channel and pressure-pipe transients.
coachella-project.evidence: Opened turn259view0 lines48–50. Historical page contains old current-condition statements which are not reused.

limits: Numerical models are declared original synthetic assumptions, not project field values.
Official indexed excerpts are identified separately from directly opened sources.
No source endorsement or investment/security listing is claimed.
